Poppy.title: Poppy’s seed basket
Poppy.identity: Shape the garden, guide returning throws, and time a roll-catch.
skills: Seed Turn
RETURN
Every fourth boomerang plants a seed where it turns. Seeds pulse at nearby bugs for 5 seconds.
A returning disc touching a seed triggers one extra pulse.
A triggered seed fires a small petal fan. Maximum 3 seeds.
Pollen Stamp
MARK
Outgoing hits mark bugs for 3 seconds. The return pops each mark once for a small burst.
Marks spread to one nearby bug when popped.
Popped marks briefly reveal a weak spot to your next throw.
Mothball Pouch
CONTROL
Drop a cluster every 30 seconds. Its scent slows nearby bugs for 6 seconds. First drop in 3 seconds.
The initial puff briefly pushes ordinary bugs outward.
The cluster leaves two smaller scent patches. Bosses resist displacement.
Dew Step
GARDEN
Rolling leaves a small puddle that slows bugs. Puddles last 6 seconds; 8-second planting cooldown.
Puddles lengthen the life of seeds they overlap, once per seed.
Leaving a puddle sends a small ripple toward the nearest enemy.
Bee Companion
COMPANION
One bee visits enemies struck by your boomerang, stinging every 2 seconds.
The bee prioritizes marked targets and returns to you between visits.
After three visits, the bee makes one piercing trip through its targets.
Pocket Fan
RETURN
Every third return pushes small bugs sideways, opening a narrow walking lane.
The gust also slows enemies that cannot be pushed.
The gust splits into two short side arcs. No permanent boss stunlock.
Catch Guard
CATCH
A successful roll-catch grants one temporary guard for 3 seconds. Cannot stack.
When that guard blocks a hit, it releases a short petal counter.
A blocked hit also readies one Seed Turn trigger; 6-second cooldown.
Petal Wake
ROLL
Rolling scatters three petals behind you. They damage bugs that cross your path.
A returning boomerang gathers those petals into its next pass.
Gathered petals fan outward on the next roll-catch.
Thirsty Roots
GARDEN
Every 12 seconds, a short root line grows toward a nearby enemy, briefly slowing it.
Roots persist briefly and pulse once when crossed by your boomerang.
Roots fork once on contact. Maximum two root lines.
combos: Bloom Patch
A seed in a puddle blooms into a small petal turret for 4 seconds. Maximum two blooms; one bloom per seed.
Pollinator Loop
Your bee links up to three marked enemies with one sweeping pass. One link per visit cycle.
Scent Sweep
A return gust crossing a mothball cluster carries its scent forward into a short slowing lane.
Petal Parry
A roll-catch gathers your nearby petals into a temporary shield, then releases them on your next throw.
Root Garden
Roots crossing a puddle spread into a short curved barrier of slowing roots. It never blocks movement.

Scout.title: Scout’s field kit
Scout.identity: Build firing lanes, lure bugs into traps, and turn dodges into precise shots.
skills: Bank Shot
SHOT
Seeds bounce once to a nearby target.
A bounce through a marked target gets one extra ricochet.
Final ricochet splits into two weaker seeds.
Acorn Decoy
TRAP
Every 18 seconds, leave a decoy that draws nearby ordinary bugs for 3 seconds.
The decoy bursts when surrounded.
The burst scatters four splinters. Bosses target you, not the decoy.
Snapline
TRAP
Rolling places two stakes with a short trip line between them.
The first enemy crossing triggers a snare pulse.
Two crossings may trigger before the line breaks.
Trail Mark
AIM
Every fourth volley marks its first target for a follow-up strike.
Marked targets pass the mark to one nearby bug when defeated.
A follow-up strike against a boss also creates a brief side opening.
Scatter Satchel
SHOT
Every sixth volley scatters a short fan of seeds.
Fan hits arm nearby traps for an early trigger.
The final fan seed pierces once.
Quickdraw Roll
ROLL
Your first volley after rolling fires a focused piercing shot.
The shot punches through one additional target.
A precise hit after narrowly dodging also fires a trailing seed.
Bark Guard
DEFENSE
A ready guard blocks one hit, then recharges after 20 seconds without damage.
Blocking emits a small outward shove.
The shove creates two short-lived bark shards that intercept bullets.
Counterseed
COUNTER
A near-miss during a roll readies a retaliatory seed.
That seed pins an ordinary bug briefly.
The pinned target releases a small seed burst when defeated.
Forager Route
PICKUP
Collecting eight seeds by hand charges a short seed ring.
The ring arms traps it crosses.
The ring carries one ricochet seed toward a nearby target.
combos: Marked Ricochet
A bounced seed hitting a marked target returns a weaker seed toward another marked target. One extra return only.
Acorn Ambush
A scatter fan hitting your decoy makes it burst early into a wider seed fan.
Tripwire Volley
A quickdraw shot crossing your line travels along it as a piercing sweep.
Bark Reprisal
Blocking with Bark Guard immediately fires your readied Counterseed.
Trail Network
A Forager ring crossing a trip line refreshes one trigger, once per line.
